## Q3: Are any of the gene targets of hit compounds from the drug screen, differentially expressed in RNA-seq? Which GO terms are they associated with and what might this tell you about the pathology of PD?

```{r}
# Load drug screen data
drug_screen_hits <- readRDS("hit_targets.rds")

# Load RNAseq DEG analysis
deg_results <- readRDS("RNAseq_expression_status.rds")

# Remove NA values from drug_screen_hits
drug_screen_hits <- na.omit(drug_screen_hits)
```

## A) Are gene targets of hit compounds differentially expressed in RNA-seq?

```{r}
overlapping_genes <- deg_results |>
  filter(gene %in% drug_screen_hits$hgnc_symbol) 

View(overlapping_genes)
```

Since the target enzyme of compound 6618 had no HGNC symbol, we are only able to look for the targets of the other three compounds (4550, 4635 and 6314). Filtering for the targets of these compounds in deg_results revealed that these target genes are up-regulated in PD.

## B) GO term association

```{r}

# Load GO terms 
go_deg <- readRDS("GO_terms.Rds")
```

```{r}
go_deg |>
  filter(gene %in% drug_screen_hits$hgnc_symbol) 
```
